name: cockpit-mountain
description: A pnpm monorepo for Cockpit core and its plugin ecosystem.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @45drives/houston-common-css run build:css && pnpm --filter @45drives/houston-common-lib run build && pnpm --filter @45drives/houston-common-ui run build && pnpm --recursive --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present --filter '!@45drives/*' run build
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:cockpit
